correctness.rationale: The 3-pebble truncation of class sizes and multiplicities gives all 63 canonical cases by an explicit back-and-forth strategy for every finite nonempty equivalence relation. The standard recursive q-type signature is exhaustive on those cases and produces 21 types; a separate direct 3-round EF solver independently verifies 210 pairwise distinctions and all 63 memberships. The maximal minimal size is 9; a rank-three sentence requiring three classes, each of size at least three, proves optimality without computation. Actual verify.py and verify_output.txt were replayed.

value.rationale: Exact low-resource expressivity over the fundamental class of finite equivalence structures is a natural finite-model-theoretic invariant. The sharp universal 9-element rank-three kernel converts satisfiability and rank-three property testing into a finite 21-representative test bed, while 21 atoms and \(2^{21}\) definable properties quantify expressivity. The bound is not a direct obvious size truncation (which only gives 18), and it is both nontrivial and sharp; the complete classification and smallest representatives are exact, not arbitrary parameter slices.
